cues.en: Hello everyone. In this video we will show you some of the techniques we use to fit our NES game micromages into 40 kilobytes. In this day and age we are used to storage media that can hold gigabytes of data. That means hours of video and many days or even weeks of music. 40 kilobytes on the other hand are barely enough to store two seconds of music in mp3 format. When the NES was conceived in the early 80s
cues.zh: 大家好。在本视频中，我们会展示一些技术，用来把我们的 NES 游戏 micromages 塞进 40 KB。如今我们已经习惯了能容纳数 GB 数据的存储介质。那意味着数小时的视频，以及许多天甚至数周的音乐。而 40 KB 只勉强够存两秒钟的 mp3 音乐。NES 在 80 年代初被构想出来时

cues.en: Electronic storage space was severely limited and expensive. Only 40 kilobytes of game data are visible to the console at one time. Without additional hardware on the cartridge to switch between multiple banks of memory, this is all the space developers could use, and none of the early games could go beyond that. As a result, these early games were usually very limited in scope. With one famous exception, Super Mario Bros.
cues.zh: 电子存储空间严重受限而且昂贵。主机同一时间只能看到 40 KB 的游戏数据。如果卡带上没有额外硬件来在多个内存 bank 之间切换，这就是开发者能使用的全部空间，早期游戏没有一个能突破这个限制。因此，这些早期游戏的内容规模通常非常有限。只有一个著名的例外：Super Mario Bros.

cues.en: Its developers managed to cram in a large number of horizontally scrolling levels into the tiny space they had, which was really impressive for the time. Fascinated by this game, we just had to see if it was still possible to create a game with the same limitations nowadays, going back to the roots of the NES. And these were our plans. A vertically scrolling platformer with a cartoonish occult theme. The core mechanics are running
cues.zh: 它的开发者设法把大量横向卷轴关卡塞进他们有限的微小空间里，这在当时真的令人印象深刻。我们被这款游戏迷住了，所以一定要看看，如今回到 NES 的根源，是否还能在同样的限制下做出游戏。而这就是我们的计划。一款纵向卷轴平台游戏，带有卡通化的神秘学主题。核心机制是奔跑

cues.en: shooting magic spells, and, to make traversing vertical levels fun, wall jumping. We want to provide an adventure with many levels and boss battles that you can go on alone or with up to four people, as we felt the NES library was truly lacking a multiplayer experience like this. To program an NES game like this, you need maximum control and speed, so we need to speak the processor's language directly, writing all code in 6502 assembly.
cues.zh: 发射法术，以及，为了让穿越纵向关卡变得有趣，蹬墙跳。我们想提供一场包含许多关卡和 Boss 战的冒险，你可以独自进行，也可以最多四人一起，因为我们觉得 NES 游戏库确实缺少这样的多人游戏体验。要编写这样的 NES 游戏，你需要最大程度的控制和速度，所以我们需要直接说处理器的语言，把所有代码都用 6502 汇编来写。

cues.en: 8 kilobytes are used for graphics and another 32 kilobytes for everything else. The graphics are split into two tables. One for background elements, the other for independently moving foreground elements, which are called sprites. Each table holds 256 graphical 8x8 pixel tiles. A single sprite on the NES can use three different colors. You can combine multiple sprites to build larger objects.
cues.zh: 8 KB 用于图形，另外 32 KB 用于其他所有内容。图形被分成两张表。一张用于背景元素，另一张用于独立移动的前景元素，也就是所谓的精灵。每张表容纳 256 个 8x8 像素的图形图块。NES 上的单个精灵可以使用三种不同的颜色。你可以组合多个精灵来构建更大的物体。

cues.en: or meta sprites, as we call them. The NES only supports four different sprite pellets at the same time, so we reserve one pellet for each player and they have to be reused for enemies. One of the most characteristic limitations of the NES is that only a maximum of eight sprites can be rendered on the same horizontal line. Excess sprites simply disappear. That's why a lot of games employ a flickering effect to allow more sprites to be seen.
cues.zh: 或者按我们的叫法，元精灵。NES 同一时间只支持四种不同的精灵调色板，所以我们为每个玩家保留一种调色板，它们必须复用于敌人。NES 最具代表性的限制之一是，同一条水平线上最多只能渲染八个精灵。多出的精灵会直接消失。这就是为什么很多游戏采用闪烁效果，让更多精灵能被看到。

cues.en: So, we decided to reduce the size of the players to avoid reaching this limit and save space in the sprite graphics table. Taking Super Mario Bros as an example, here's the space used by all of Mario's graphics. You can see that the choice of smaller sprites allowed us to bring diversity and fluidity into the main character's movements and ultimately left space for more content. For example, different bosses. Speaking of which...
cues.zh: 所以，我们决定缩小角色尺寸，避免达到这个上限，并节省精灵图形表里的空间。以 Super Mario Bros 为例，这是 Mario 所有图形占用的空间。可以看到，选择更小的精灵让我们能为主角动作带来多样性和流畅性，最终也为更多内容留出了空间。比如不同的 Boss。说到这个……

cues.en: We had to come up with a couple of tricks to be able to store them at all. For example, these are all the individual frames used for the first world's boss. If we store the sprite graphics like this, our dream of making this NES game will end right here. So here's what we do instead. First, we split this big meta sprite into three parts that can be animated independently of each other. Let's decompose these parts into individual sprites,
cues.zh: 为了能把它们存下来，我们不得不想出几个技巧。比如，这些是第一世界 Boss 用到的所有单独帧。如果像这样存精灵图形，我们做这款 NES 游戏的梦想就到此为止了。所以我们换一种做法。首先，把这个大的元精灵拆成三个可以独立播放动画的部分。让我们把这些部分拆解成一个个精灵，

cues.en: and see if there are any graphics that are the same. We only need to keep one instance of a sprite tile and can then reuse it as many times as we need to. The NES is also capable of flipping sprites vertically and horizontally, which allows us to reduce the number of individual sprite tiles even more. As you can see, we optimize the top part quite a bit, from 16 individual sprite tiles down to 4. For the middle part, let's continue in the same fashion.
cues.zh: 看看有没有相同的图形。一个精灵图块我们只需要保留一份，然后按需复用多次。NES 还能垂直和水平翻转精灵，这让我们能进一步减少单独的精灵图块数量。可以看到，我们把顶部优化了不少，从 16 个单独精灵图块降到 4 个。中间部分也照同样方式继续。

cues.en: The bottom part has five animation frames, but the last two are flipped versions of the first two. And again, we reduce the amount of individual tiles as much as possible. With these kinds of optimizations, we could save a lot of graphics space, which allowed us to add more content. In order to have a reasonable number of levels, finding a good way of compressing level maps is crucial. So let's go into that next. First,
cues.zh: 底部有五个动画帧，但后两个是前两个的翻转版本。我们同样尽可能减少单独图块的数量。通过这类优化，我们省下了大量图形空间，从而能加入更多内容。为了做出合理数量的关卡，找到压缩关卡地图的好方法至关重要。所以接下来就讲这个。首先，

cues.en: A background is made from many 8x8 pixel tiles. At 1 byte per tile, disregarding color information, a full screen would use 960 bytes. That's almost a full kilobyte, which is quite a lot. So, we add a layer of abstraction, which we call meta tiles. And then we use the same trick on those again, ending up with meta tiles of meta tiles. With this technique, a full screen will use only 60 bytes.
cues.zh: 背景由许多 8x8 像素图块组成。如果不考虑颜色信息，每个图块 1 字节，一整屏会用到 960 字节。这几乎是一整千字节，相当多。于是我们加了一层抽象，称为元图块。然后对它们再用同样的技巧，最终得到元元图块。用这种技术，一整屏只会用到 60 字节。

cues.en: This is a graphics table where we store all the background tiles used in the game. Here's how we build meta tiles. Each world has its own tileset, and tilesets do take up space on their own, so there are some tricks we employed there as well, but for the sake of simplicity, I will not go into detail about them in this video. Now, with these meta tiles, we can build tilesets of meta meta tiles.
cues.zh: 这是一张图形表，用来存放游戏里用到的所有背景图块。下面说明我们如何构建元图块。每个世界都有自己的图块集，而图块集本身也会占空间，所以我们也用了些技巧，但为了简单起见，这个视频里就不展开讲了。现在，有了这些元图块，我们就能构建由元元图块组成的图块集。

cues.en: Finally, we can start building the background for one screen. Even if 60 bytes don't seem like much, the total map data of the game was still relatively large, so we searched for other ways to optimize it. And so we thought. What if the levels were symmetric? Okay, so let's remove half of the screen and mirror the left side. Ending up at 30 bytes per screen. Unfortunately, the gameplay suffered from this.
cues.zh: 最后，我们可以开始为单个屏幕构建背景。即使 60 字节看起来不多，游戏的总地图数据仍然相当大，所以我们寻找其他优化方式。于是我们想：如果关卡是对称的呢？好，那就去掉屏幕的一半，把左侧镜像过去。结果每屏降到 30 字节。可惜，玩法因此受损。

cues.en: it quickly became clear that completely symmetrical levels were too bland and just not fun to play. But wait, there is a solution. Expanding on what was mentioned earlier, one meta meta tile on the map is stored as an index into the tile set and uses one byte. One byte is made up of 8 bits. In our meta meta tile sets, we only use a limited number of tiles. So, as you can see,
cues.zh: 很快我们就发现，完全对称的关卡太单调，玩起来也不有趣。但等等，有办法。接着刚才说的，地图上的一个元元图块会作为图块集的索引存储，占用一个字节。一个字节由 8 位组成。在我们的元元图块集里，只用到有限数量的图块。所以，如你所见，

cues.en: The highest bit will never be used in the tileset index. That means that, at 4 meta meta tiles per row, we can use 4 bits to store another value. We use these 4 bits to enable shifting the mirror axis of individual rows of tiles, breaking up the symmetry and allowing for more diverse level design while still only using 30 bytes per screen. Of course, let's not forget that levels are much bigger than just a single screen.
cues.zh: 最高位在图块集索引中永远不会被用到。这意味着，在一行 4 个元元图块时，我们可以用 4 位来存储另一个值。我们用这 4 位来逐行移动镜像轴，打破对称性，允许更多样化的关卡设计，同时仍然每屏只占 30 字节。当然，别忘了关卡可比一屏大得多。

cues.en: So the cumulative savings achieved by all the aforementioned techniques are quite substantial. Finally, all of these saved bytes allowed us to add a hard mode. In those classic games that have one, hard mode often means something along the lines of play the same game again, but with more resilient enemies. With the remaining space, we wanted to provide a more unique challenge than that. Adding new tricks to the enemy's repertoire was possible.
cues.zh: 所以，上述所有技术累计节省的空间相当可观。最终，这些省下来的字节让我们能加入困难模式。在那些有困难模式的经典游戏里，困难模式通常意味着再玩一遍同样的游戏，但敌人更耐打。利用剩余空间，我们想提供比这更独特的挑战。给敌人的招式库加入新花招是可行的。

cues.en: Designing completely new levels, on the other hand, not so much. Well, let's see what we ended up with. Changing the existing levels' palettes is an easy trick that does not use many bytes. To make changes in the level layout, we opt for updating tiles in key locations only. With this method, the hard mode level data ended up using roughly 7 bytes per screen on average.
cues.zh: 另一方面，设计全新的关卡就没那么容易了。好吧，看看我们最终做成了什么。更改现有关卡调色板是一个简单技巧，不占多少字节。要对关卡布局做改动，我们只选择更新关键位置的图块。用这种方法，困难模式的关卡数据平均每屏大约只用了 7 字节。

cues.en: It's a bit of a generous statement, but you could say this allowed the game to have twice the amount of content at the total extra cost of only a couple hundred bytes. So, now you know some of the tricks we used to make this game possible. We are glad to present this project to you and hope you will enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed making it. Thanks for watching!
cues.zh: 这说法有点慷慨，但可以说，这让游戏的内容量翻了一倍，而总额外成本只有几百字节。现在，你知道了我们让这款游戏成为可能所用的一些技巧。我们很高兴向你展示这个项目，也希望你玩起来能像我们制作时一样享受。感谢观看！
